notes.title: What's new in version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313355/0f29d8f611611987e357e95579bce11a6ee2819d.png[/img]

Hey Cosmic Riders! 
We're bringing [b]new ways to play, fresh tracks to master, and some stellar improvements[/b] to enhance your karting experience. Let’s jump in!  

[h2][b]New features:[/b][/h2]
- [b]Play with friends:[/b] Easily team up with 4 other players, form your own racing squad, and dominate the galaxy, because victories are better with friends!   
- [b]6 new tracks:[/b] Fresh cosmic challenges await, discover and master these brand-new cosmic tracks.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313355/de7ca154846edfbd97845766562f27fb2c5731bd.png[/img]

[h2][b]Quality of life & gameplay upgrades:[/b][/h2]
- Improved orbital camera for smoother racing views.  
- New pilot poses added in the customization menu: strike a pose before hitting the track!  
- Victory & upset animations
- Show player's name: toggle now available in the options menu to display Cosmic Riders names mid-race.  
- Watchtower & Wavering bounces now feel smoother.  
- Dark chase overhaul:  Adjusted the dark matter behavior and removed certain obstacles in Dark Chase. Dark Chase is now only available as a final round track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313355/2c1db2dd6ad0615f1c9e2d721ed58ff1697c2e9f.png[/img]

 [h2][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h2]
- Fixed incorrect jumps when boosting too early on ramps.
- Resolved a 3D kart duplication bug when exiting the shop's offer details too quickly.
- Customization menu now properly displays your pilot's colors.  
- Removed the ability to go back with right-click during races (mouse users).
- Fixed the Cosmic Pass reward preview issue.
- Options menu now properly disappears in Spectator mode.
- Addressed a bug causing the shop menu to jump to a specific category when using shortcuts.
- You can now close the Options menu with the Start button.
- Fixed a bug where players could be launched excessively high.
- Fixed a floating kart animation in the reward sequence menu.
- Fixed missing character animations on the podium.
- Fixed a glitch with the Main Menu banner displaying incorrectly at the first frame.
- Resolved a fly-over track cinematic glitch at the end of the Und'AirControl track.
- Fixed a similar fly-over track glitch on the Techno Ziggurat track.
- Input icons now correctly disappear when the gamepad is disconnected.
- The mouse no longer vanishes when switching to keyboard controls.
- Fixed an issue causing the mouse to disappear upon right-click.
- Fixed incorrect input icons in the Vehicle Paint Menu when switching from Paint to Pattern mode.

And many more minor fixes and tweaks to keep your races smooth!  

[h2][b]Jump back in now! [/b][/h2]
With friends lobbies and new tracks, there's never been a better time to play Cosmic Royale! Rally your squad, master the fresh tracks, and show the Cosmic Royale Festikart who's the champion!

notes.title: What's new in version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313355/bbf87eee33f1828e9695498ecf1e909861537b68.jpg[/img]

Hey Cosmic Riders!

We’ve got a new update with festive vibes to improve your karting experience. Here’s what’s new:  

[h2][b]New Features:[/b][/h2]
- Meet Metalimut! A new pilot has joined the cosmic race: Metalimut, the metal version of our lovely Azimut, is now available in the shop. Say hello to Metalimut, the sleek and unstoppable slime ready to take the cosmic tracks by storm. Make him your next cosmic companion!  
- Holiday Celebration: Celebrate the season with our brand-new Christmas Pack in the shop and a cozy Christmas-themed main menu. It’s time to compete with a holiday twist! :christmas_tree: 

[h2][b]Game Enhancements:[/b][/h2]
- Smarter AI Management: AI racers now auto-qualify in A to B races once all human competitors are done. Less waiting, more karting!  
- Quicker Lobby Times: We’ve trimmed the waiting times in lobbies. Get back on the track faster than ever.  

[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]
- Resolved the white flash issue at the start of the reward sequence.  
- Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Cosmic Royale Season 0 is available now!
notes.notes:
Cosmic Royale Season 0 is officially live! It’s time to buckle up, race through the cosmos, and experience the thrill of intergalactic karting like never before. 

[previewyoutube=MB9Vx8WzBsI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Jump into the action[/h2]
Season 0 is your first taste of Cosmic Royale’s chaotic fun! With multiple dynamic game modes: A to B Race, Mortal Race and Survival Mode but also 13 thrilling tracks, every race is a cosmic adventure waiting to happen.

- 9 epic kart parts to upgrade your kart.
- The adorable pilot Powehi to lead you to victory. 
Complete the Premium Founder Pass and get rewarded for playing!
